Image 1 is the product photo of the necklace, worn on a linen display bust. Image 2 is a close detail of the front of the same necklace. Use Image 1 and Image 2 only for the necklace itself: a gold-tone necklace made of a row of small five-petal flowers linked edge to edge, each petal one pale pink marquise stone held in a gold claw setting, with a tiny clear stone at the centre of each flower; at the front centre, a pair of spread gold wings with fine beaded texture, each wing holding one deep magenta marquise stone, the wings meeting at a small faceted gold centre; and two fine gold cable chains, exactly two, hanging below in two overlapping swags that cross once. Each wing tip is linked directly to the nearest flower; the chains hang from the flowers on either side and pass below the wings without being attached to them. Define the necklace in Image 1 and Image 2 as <Subject 1>. <Subject 1> is identical in every shot: the same gold tone, five petals on every flower, the same stone colours, one pair of wings, two chain swags. The linen bust and the green wall of the photos are never shown.

A 12-second vertical luxury jewellery film of <Subject 1>, shot like a high-jewellery campaign: eight hard cuts, mostly macro on a clean black set, one sequence worn on a woman's collarbones, ending on a held hero shot. <Subject 1> is the only star: large in frame, sharp, glittering. Every frame is something a real macro crew could film in a studio in a day.

Hard cuts only throughout: every shot is a completely separate camera setup. No transitions, no dissolves, no wipes, no morphing, no motion carrying across a cut.

Real photography, inherited by every shot: filmed on an ARRI Alexa 35 with a 100 mm macro lens at low ISO, genuine optical depth of field with a soft focus falloff, the slow-motion shot on a Phantom at 1000 frames per second. A black velvet set, one hard spot key light and a soft warm fill. Slow, controlled camera motion only. Materials behave exactly as in life: the gold is polished and truly reflective, the pink stones are translucent with soft inner light and sharp starburst glints on their facets, the magenta stones are deeper and darker, the chains are fine and fluid, skin shows pores and fine hairs. Deep clean blacks, no beauty smoothing, no plastic sheen, no smudged detail, no over-sharpening.

Global look: low-key and rich, vertical 9:16. Deep black backgrounds, warm yellow gold, soft pink and magenta stones, crisp white glints. <Subject 1> always reads sharp and correctly drawn.

Audio, inherited by every shot: quiet studio sound only: a soft metallic tick as light catches the gold, fine chain links brushing each other, silk rustling, a breath. No music and no voices.

Never render: anything physically impossible, such as an object that appears out of nothing, grows or changes shape on camera; the linen bust or the green wall from the photos; the photos themselves, a grid or a split screen; any text, letters, logos, numbers, engravings, hallmarks, tags or price labels anywhere; extra flowers at the centre, flowers with four or six petals, extra wings, a third chain or extra chain loops, chains attached to the wings, added diamonds, pearls or pendants; stones of any other colour; a second necklace; earrings, rings or other jewellery; hands touching the necklace; a face above the lips; plastic-looking or orange gold; captions or watermarks; slow motion on more than one shot.

[00:00.0] Extreme macro on black velvet, near-total darkness: a single hard light rises and reveals one flower of <Subject 1>, its five pale pink marquise stones in their gold claws and the tiny clear stone at the centre, sharp starburst glints sliding over the facets. The camera drifts slowly to the right.

[00:01.6] Extreme macro on the centre of <Subject 1> on black velvet: the two spread gold wings with their fine beaded texture, a deep magenta marquise stone on each, the faceted gold centre between them, each wing tip linked to a pink flower at the frame edge, the light rising across them. The camera pushes in slowly.

[00:03.2] Macro at a low angle along the row of flowers of <Subject 1> lying on black velvet: the nearest flower sharp, the others falling away into soft pink and gold bokeh, the chains glinting beneath. The camera tracks along the row, slowly.

[00:04.7] Medium shot on black: <Subject 1> hangs by its two ends from above the frame in an open curve, swaying very slightly, the two chain swags swinging and catching the light, the wings at the centre. The camera is locked off.

[00:06.2] Close shot of a woman's neck and collarbones, framed from just below her lips to her chest: warm brown skin, the edge of a deep emerald silk blouse on her shoulders, <Subject 1> resting on her collarbones exactly as in Image 1, with its two chain swags. She breathes in and turns her shoulders slightly toward a soft warm key light, and the stones glint. The camera pushes in slowly.

[00:07.9] Macro on the same wearer: the gold wings and the two nearest flowers of <Subject 1> on her skin, pores and fine hairs visible, the chains resting in the hollow of her collarbone, glints moving as she breathes. The camera is locked off.

[00:09.2] Phantom slow motion from directly above: <Subject 1> lies in a curve on polished black stone while real pink flower petals fall past the lens and settle around it, none covering the wings. The camera is locked off.

[00:10.4] Final hero, straight on at eye level: the whole of <Subject 1> on a black velvet neck stand, centred, the flowers, the wings and both chain swags complete and sharp, a warm rim light on the gold against deep black. The camera pushes in very slowly, then holds still for the last half second.

Throughout: <Subject 1> keeps its exact design from Image 1 and Image 2, sharp and correctly drawn in every shot. Everything obeys real physics. Keep it subtitle-free: no captions, no watermarks, no text. No music and no voices.
